name: Fatboy Slim
description: The iconic British DJ brings his infectious energy to Porto for a massive open-air show. Get ready to dance the night away to legendary big beat anthems under the stars.
longDescription:
Norman Cook, known professionally as Fatboy Slim, is a British DJ, musician, and record producer. He rose to prominence in the 1990s with a distinctive blend of big beat, breakbeat, and electronic dance music, achieving global success with tracks like "Praise You," "The Rockafeller Skank," and "Right Here, Right Now." His career spans decades, marked by numerous awards and headline performances at major festivals worldwide. This event sees him bringing his extensive catalogue of work to Porto for a dedicated performance.

Attendees can expect an energetic outdoor concert at The Park, featuring a setlist drawn from Fatboy Slim's career. The atmosphere will be geared towards dancing, with the event taking place in the evening under the open sky. The Park is an outdoor venue, providing ample space for a large audience to gather for the performance. The event is categorized as music, indicating a focus on the live DJ set.

Tickets for the event are available starting from €30. The show is scheduled for May 1, 2026. Further details regarding public transport access to The Park and specific accessibility information are typically provided closer to the event date by the organizers.
